messages:
Maya (Support): FYI — ACME reported intermittent schema parse failures in prod. They get 200 but their pydantic parser throws JSONDecodeError ~10% of the time. Attaching their example and repro notes below.

Customer (ACME Inc.): Here is a representative response we received when we concatenated streaming chunks (we use the Node SDK with stream=true):

```json
{"user_id": 123, "items": [
  {"id": "a1", "score": 0.92},
  {"id": "b2", "score": 0.87}
]}
```

But sometimes the stream arrives like this (chunks shown separately):

chunk 1:
```json
{"user_id":123,"items":[{"id":"a1","score":0.92},
```

chunk 2 (heartbeat sometimes):
```
null
```

chunk 3:
```json
,{"id":"b2","score":0.87}]}
```

Concatenating those gives invalid JSON (`...0.92},null,{"id"...`) and pydantic blows up. We don't inject any extra separators — we just buffer and JSON.parse at the end.

Leo (Eng-ML): Thanks, this looks like a streaming-heartbeat issue. Do you know the request_id and whether they set response_format=json vs json_stream vs stream=true? Also any client-side logs?

Maya (Support): They set `stream=true` and `response_format=json` in the SDK call. Request id: req_0x9fa7b21. They attached logs showing the three chunks above. They also reported a billing spike (retries) because their app retried on parse errors — invoice line shows ~3x token usage for that day.

Anne (Eng-Runtime): Repro attempt: ran curl with `--no-buffer` to emulate streaming. Observed runtime emitting a small heartbeat payload `null` between token chunks when KV cache updates flush. Example server-side stream sequence: `{"user_id":123,"items":[{"id":"a1","score":0.92},` <heartbeat `null`> `,{"id":"b2","score":0.87}]}`. That heartbeat is meant as an internal keepalive but is breaking naive concatenation.

Leo (Eng-ML): Ah — heartbeat should never appear as a raw top-level token when response_format is JSON. Two angles: customer can parse frames (tolerant streaming parser) or we fix runtime to emit NDJSON frames (one JSON object per line) or use a heartbeat envelope like `{ "hb": true }` so it doesn't break a single-object parser.

Maya (Support): Customer says changing their parser is not feasible right now. They asked for a server-side quick fix or a guidance/workaround. Also asked for a credit for the retry-driven usage spike.

Anne (Eng-Runtime): Action plan: 1) Short-term hotfix — stop emitting raw `null` heartbeats for `response_format=json` + `stream=true`. Instead send a no-op JSON envelope or skip the heartbeat entirely. 2) Medium — formalize streaming contract (NDJSON or envelope schema) and update SDKs. I'll open ENG-RT ticket with request_id and logs.

deploy-bot: Canaries queued for ENG-RT-314 (hotfix) — deploy window target: next 4-hour patch window.

Leo (Eng-ML): Also add automated test that concatenates typical chunk sequences and runs through pydantic/jsonschema validators to catch regressions.

Maya (Support): I'll respond to ACME: temporary workaround — toggle stream=false in the SDK or use the SDK's built-in streaming parser which handles heartbeats, and we'll credit the overage while we fix. Will attach ticket ENG-RT-314 and ETA. :white_check_mark:

Customer (ACME Inc.): Thanks — please keep us posted. We can switch to non-stream mode for now. Appreciate the credit. :pray:
notes: Repro focused on streaming heartbeats causing invalid top-level JSON when clients naively concatenate chunks. Contains request id and action items assigned to eng-runtime.
